content.short: HypurrFi is a HyperEVM lending protocol for borrowing against holdings and earning yield.
content.description: HypurrFi lets users borrow against their holdings on HyperEVM, spend the proceeds and earn yield on deposits, with a deliberately simple entry path into more advanced positions. Its pooled markets rank among the larger lending deployments on the chain by value locked.
content.meta: Borrow against holdings on HyperEVM, with a simple entry into more advanced positions.
